recipes.name: Vegan Crêpes
instructions: Mix the batter ingredients in a large bowl until smooth. Place it in the fridge for at least 1 hour, or overnight*.
When ready to cook, heat a crêpe pan over medium heat. Use a paper towel dipped in vegetable oil to lightly grease the pan.
Pour about ¼ cup of batter into the pan and use a crêpe spreader or lift the pan and rotate it to spread the batter out thinly. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the bottom is golden.
Flip the crêpe over and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to a plate and cover with a clean cloth to keep warm. Repeat until all the crêpes are cooked.
Load each crêpe with desired fillings, like chocolate spread and fruit, or a squeeze of lemon with a sprinkle of sugar. Roll or fold, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes If refrigerating overnight, allow the batter to come to room temperature before using so that it's not too thick, or simply add a small splash of milk to thin it out a touch.

Storage The batter can be made in advance and stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a day. Cooked crêpes can be stored separately from the fillings in the fridge for up to 2 days, but topped crêpes are best enjoyed immediately.
